ETHICS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 8, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

Barbara A. Pollack, Chair  Margo Morales, Commissioner
Chief Coleman, Vice Chair  J. P. Shotwell, Commissioner
Raul Añorve, Commissioner  Susan Wise, Commissioner
Lani De Benedictis, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-56010  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Ethics Commission meeting of
  Wednesday, December 11, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-53996  Recommendation to receive and file amendments to the Conflict of Interest Code
  regarding City Auditor and Public Utilities.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-53997  Recommendation to identify and discuss remaining open items on the Ethics
  Commission’s Original 2020 Action Plan and the 2019 Harvey Rose Audit and
  make recommendations for implementation considerations into the Office of Ethics
  and Transparency’s 5-year Strategic Roadmap.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-53998  Recommendation to receive and file oral reports from the attendees of the 2024
  Council of Governmental Ethics Laws conference.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-53999  Recommendation to receive and file an update from the Ad Hoc Committee on
  Updated Policies.

  Page 1 of 4
   ETHICS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 8, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-54000  Recommendation to discuss timeline and steps needed to have a complete Ethics
  Ordinance recommendation, including lobbying proposal, to City Council in March
  2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  25-54001  Recommendation to receive and file an update from the Ad Hoc Committee on the
  2024 PNE (Primary Nominating Election) Candidate Filings.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  25-54002  Recommendation to receive and file an update from the Ad Hoc Committee on
  Commission Responsibilities.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  25-54003  Recommendation to discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects;
  and, if appropriate, take action to dissolve, create or reauthorize Ad Hoc
  Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

10. 25-54004  Recommendation to discuss and make recommendations for a 2025 Ethics
  Commission meeting calendar.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

11. 25-54005  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Ethics Officer.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

12. 25-54006  Recommendation to discuss potential agenda items for future Commission
  meetings.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Ethics Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.
